items.title: US credit card debt hits record $1.29 trillion in third quarter
items.summary: Investing.com -- Credit card balances in the United States rose by $22 billion in the third quarter to reach a record $1.29 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt report released today. The balances increased 4.2% compared to the same period last year.

items.title: Mastercard CEO Reveals His Biggest Cybersecurity Concern
items.summary: Mastercard CEO Michael Miebach says cybersecurity is the issue that keeps him up at night. Speaking with Alan Murray at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Miebach discusses the growing challenge of protecting critical financial infrastructure as cyber threats become increasingly difficult to manage.
